s: October 29, 2024 - Kiddyland, also known as Kiddy Land, or 株式会社キデイランド (Kiddyland Co., Ltd.)[1] in Japanese, is a tax-free toy store in Japan.[2] They exist as an online store as well as multiple physical locations in Japan that you can visit, including locations in Harajuku[3] and Umeda.[4] In regards to Popee the Performer, Kiddyland sold a lot of Popee the Performer merchandise on their website, as well as at their physical locations.
